teaser.en: Its flowers look like single white roses, and its hard, shiny fruits were once hollowed out as snuff boxes.
teaser.sw: Maua yake yanafanana na waridi jeupe la porini, na matunda yake magumu yanayong'aa zamani yalitobolewa kutengeneza vibweta vya tumbaku ya kunusa.
teaser.dg: Maruwage ganaonekana dza maruwa mereru ga *waridi* ga tsaka, na matundage magumu ganayonyiririka kare ganasekulwa kuhenda viko vya tumbaku.

summary.en: *Mtondoo* is the snuff-box tree, a spiny shrub with large white rose-like flowers and hard, round, shiny fruits. The Digo count it as the 'female' *mnyondoya*, linking it to the governor's plum.
summary.sw: *Mtondoo* ni mti uitwao kwa Kiingereza *snuff-box tree*, kichaka chenye miiba, maua makubwa meupe yanayofanana na waridi, na matunda magumu ya mviringo yanayong'aa. Wadigo huuhesabu kuwa *mnyondoya* 'jike', na hivyo kuuhusisha na mgovigovi.
summary.dg: *Mtondoo* ni *snuff-box tree* kpwa Chingereza, chitsaka chenye miya chenye maruwa makulu mereru dza ga *waridi*, na matunda magumu ga mviringo ganayonyiririka. Adigo anauona dza *mnyondoya* 'mchetu', na kpwa hivyo anauunganisha na *mnyondoya*.

about.en: *Mtondoo* is a spiny shrub or small tree. Its flowers are its glory: large and white, with a boss of golden stamens at the centre, much like a single wild rose. The fruits are hard, round and shiny, ripening from green to yellow-brown, with a shell tough enough to rattle when the seeds dry inside.
about.sw: *Mtondoo* ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye miiba. Fahari yake ni maua yake: makubwa na meupe, yenye kishungi cha stameni za rangi ya dhahabu katikati, kama waridi moja la porini. Matunda yake ni magumu, ya mviringo na yanayong'aa, yakiiva kutoka kijani hadi manjano-hudhurungi, na ganda lake ni gumu kiasi kwamba hutoa mlio mbegu zinapokauka ndani yake.
about.dg: *Mtondoo* ni chitsaka au muhi mdide wenye miya. Maruwage ndigo uzuriwe: ni makulu na mereru, na kahi-kahi kuna kundi ra nyuzi za rangi ya zahabu, dza ruwa ra *waridi* ra tsaka. Matunda ni magumu, ga mviringo na ganayonyiririka, ganayoivwa kula ga chijani hadi ga rangi ya mandano na dongo, na gadare ni gumu, hata tembe zichiuma ndani zinapiga sauti.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in thicket.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu na katika vichaka vizito.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na vitsakani.

culture.en: The Digo consider *mtondoo* the 'female' *mnyondoya*, because, like the governor's plum (*Flacourtia*), it has thorns. Pairing plants as male and female is a common way of grouping related-looking plants in Digo.
culture.sw: Wadigo huuona *mtondoo* kuwa *mnyondoya* 'jike', kwa sababu, kama mgovigovi (*Flacourtia*), una miiba. Kuoanisha mimea kama dume na jike ni njia ya kawaida katika Kidigo ya kupanga pamoja mimea inayofanana kwa sura.
culture.dg: Adigo anauona *mtondoo* kukala *mnyondoya* 'mchetu', kpwa sababu dza *mnyondoya* (*Flacourtia*), una miya. Kuika mimea airi-airi, mlume na mchetu, ni njira ya kawaida ya Chidigo ya kukusanya phamwenga mimea inayoigana.

names.en: Pakia records two Digo names, *mtondoo* and *mnyondoya mchetu* ('female *mnyondoya*'). In English it is the snuff-box tree, after the old use of its hollowed fruit shells across Africa. No Swahili name has been recorded.
names.sw: Pakia inarekodi majina mawili ya Kidigo, *mtondoo* na *mnyondoya mchetu* ('*mnyondoya* jike'). Kwa Kiingereza ni *snuff-box tree*, kutokana na matumizi ya zamani kote Afrika ya maganda ya matunda yake yaliyotobolewa. Hakuna jina la Kiswahili lililorekodiwa.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika madzina mairi ga Chidigo, *mtondoo* na *mnyondoya mchetu*. Kpwa Chingereza ni *snuff-box tree*, kpwa sababu ya kare ya kuhumira magada ga matundage garigosekulwa dza viko vya tumbaku kosi Afrika. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili ririroandikpwa.
